incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Silverline VPC (vpc-silverline-prod) high 5xx rate detected in dedicated pool 'silverline-dp-01'. Error rate ~18% sustained for 6m. Paging on-call.

emma: Ack. I'm oncall. Looking at pool metrics now, attaching dashboard link: https://redwood.app/dash/pool/silverline-dp-01

devon: I see bursting from tenant t-silverline-legacy. CPU + GPU queue latency spike, mem pressure on nodes 3 and 4. Likely noisy-tenant impact causing eviction thrash.

raj: Can you check tenant throttles + per-tenant qps? If it's tenant-level, we can do live eviction / isolate to fallback pool.

alicia: Running quick probe: `rctl tenants list --pool silverline-dp-01 --json | jq '.[] | select(.id=="t-silverline-legacy")'`
alicia: Output: `{"id":"t-silverline-legacy","qps":4200,"tokens/s":18000,"errors":0.21}` — spikes correlate with their scheduled nightly batch.

leo: Customer told us yesterday they shipped a new batch job. Sam-cs, are they aware this might be causing sustained load?

sam-cs: On a call with their SREs now. They confirm >4k qps batch started 22:12 UTC. They asked for a mitigation that preserves SLA for others. They asked us not to drop their jobs outright without coordination.

emma: Options: 1) soft-throttle t-silverline-legacy to 800 qps, 2) evict & migrate to overflow pool (silverline-overflow), or 3) drain nodes 3/4 and rebuild. Preferred minimal customer impact is overflow migration.

devon: Migration path: attach tenant to overflow pool with lower latency/throughput guarantee but keeps jobs running. Command: `rctl tenant move --tenant t-silverline-legacy --from silverline-dp-01 --to silverline-overflow --mode live` (will attempt live KV + cache warm).

raj: Note: overflow is a mixed-quantized pool; generation latency may increase. We should enable fallback routing for their critical routes to hosted-api fallback to avoid timeouts.

alicia: Initiating live migration now. Starting steps: pre-warm KV cache, create ephemeral route on silverline-overflow, start traffic mirroring at 10%.

alicia: `> rctl tenant move ...` returned job-id `mv-20240105-0932` — mirroring at 10%, metrics look stable so far.

emma: Mirroring succeeded at 10%. Error rate on pool dropping to ~5% after 12m. I'll ramp to 50% then 100% if stable.

leo: Customer rep: "Thanks — please avoid killing the batch, we can accept slightly higher latency." They requested a post-incident credit if opt-in eviction happens.

devon: Once at 100%, we should evict any leftover KV-backed sessions on nodes 3/4 to restore normal serving. Also open a maintenance window to reprovision nodes.

emma: Ramp to 100% done. Pool error rate back to 0.6% across silverline-dp-01 and silverline-overflow combined. Queue latency normalized. Marking incident mitigated for routing SLO.

sam-cs: Customer asks for formal comms + proposed credits due to degraded experience (they saw slow completions for ~28 minutes). I'll draft customer note: timeline + actions + recommended credits.

jensen-cto: Heads up for exec email: short summary + ask for approval of credit up to 10% monthly commit (or fixed $X). Please draft and tag me.

emma: Action items: 1) sam-cs to send customer summary and credit proposal. 2) devon + alicia to schedule node reprovision (nodes 3/4) and post-mortem. 3) raj to propose a tenant throttling policy to avoid future midnight batch impact. 4) jensen to review credit ask. I'll create incident doc and RCA draft.

sam-cs: Draft ready, saving to incident doc: https://redwood.app/incidents/1705001111
sam-cs: Customer comm excerpt: "We mitigated service degradation by migrating your batch to an overflow pool to protect other customers. We propose a 7% credit on January monthly commit to compensate 28m of increased latency. Please confirm acceptance."

jensen-cto: 7% sounds reasonable. +1 provisional; finance to confirm $ impact. cc: finance.

emma: Closing thread for live mitigation. We'll convert to an RCA thread with timeline, root cause (noisy nightly batch + lack of tenant-level throttles), mitigation, and action owners. Follow-up meeting scheduled 2024-01-06 15:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident ticket #INC-20240105-171 opened and linked to this thread. Status -> mitigated (actions pending).
